gloss: to be finished, to be completed

definitions.gloss: to be finished, to be completed, to turn out
definitions.explanation: For something being made or prepared to reach its completed state. Describes the result of a process, often with a nuance of how well the result turned out.

examples.japanese: ケーキがきれいに{仕上|しあ}がった。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}がようやく{仕上|しあ}がった。
{思|おも}った{以上|いじょう}にいい{作品|さくひん}に{仕上|しあ}がって、{自分|じぶん}でも{驚|おどろ}いている。
examples.english: It turned out to be a better piece than I expected, and even I'm surprised.

notes:
CONJUGATION: {仕上|しあ}がる is a godan verb. Te-form: {仕上|しあ}がって.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きれいに{仕上|しあ}がる (to turn out beautifully)
- うまく{仕上|しあ}がる (to turn out well)
- {見事|みごと}に{仕上|しあ}がる (to turn out splendidly)

The transitive counterpart is {仕上|しあ}げる (to finish, to complete something). {仕上|しあ}がる is intransitive and focuses on the result — how the completed product turned out.
